messages:
maria_support: Hey team, urgent: customer `Printly` reporting ~30% 5xxs and a lot of timeouts since 09:02 UTC. Support ticket #9872 attached. They say requests hang ~12s then 504.
ben_oncall: On it. Any reproducible example? Which model/route?
maria_support: Hitting hosted /v1/generate with model=redwood-2-large, typical seq len ~1024, concurrency 16 from their side. Example curl in ticket:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2-large","input":"summarize ...","max_tokens":512}'
```
maria_support: They also included a dump of latency traces showing long queue wait before worker assignment.
ops_bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0421-23 | severity: high | channel: #incidents.
ben_oncall: Loading metrics now. Querying grafana: `sum(rate(requests_total{env=\"hosted\",route=~\"/v1/generate\"}[1m])) by (tenant)` and `max(request_queue_depth{pool=\"hosted\"})`
leo_infra: I see request_queue_depth spike to ~1800 at 09:03 UTC on pool hosted-eu-west. Our soft limit is 1200, hard limit 1500 — looks like bursts pushed us to eviction and tail timeouts.
sara_sre: Also seeing continuous-batching backlog grow: `cbatcher_pending_batches{pool=\"hosted-eu-west\"}` jumped from 20 -> 420. KV-cache misses spiked too.
ben_oncall: Repro locally with their payload + concurrency 16, I can reproduce tail 504s after sustained load. Root cause looks like ingress pileup + long seq requests creating oversized batches that block throughput.
kevin_support: Customer is on a paid hosted tier with SLA. They're pissed, asking for ETA and a workaround.
maria_support: Please advise mitigation ASAP so we can give them steps.
ben_oncall: Immediate mitigations: 1) recommend customer reduce client concurrency to 4 and add exponential backoff; 2) enable header `X-Prefer-Fallback: redwood-2-medium` to route them to smaller model until we clear backlog; 3) apply temporary tenant rate-limit increase? (ops)
leo_infra: We can flip a routing rule to divert traffic for that tenant to dedicated fallback pool, but need approval. Quick patch: increase soft queue limit to 2000 for 10m on hosted-eu-west while we drain. Doing now.
ops_bot: Change request submitted: increase_queue_soft_limit hosted-eu-west -> 2000 for 10m (initiated by leo_infra).
sara_sre: While soft limit increase will reduce early rejects, it may increase tail latency for everyone. Suggest we also enable aggressive KV-cache prewarm for redwood-2-large to reduce batch exec time. Pushing prewarm job.
ben_oncall: I'm going to scale up worker counts (+2 nodes) in the pool and adjust batcher max_batch_size from 64 -> 48 to avoid giant batches. Applying now.
leo_infra: Worker scale +2 done. Batcher config set to 48. Monitoring.
ben_oncall: After changes, queue_depth peaked lower and tail 95p dropped from 11.2s -> 2.8s for the impacted tenant. Still seeing intermittent 5xxs during drain.
kevin_support: Passing mitigation steps to customer: reduce concurrency, use fallback header, we increased their soft limit temporarily and scaled pool. They asked for ETA on full fix.
maria_support: Customer confirmed reduced errors after followups. They want root-cause postmortem.
sara_sre: Next steps: 1) run a postmortem; 2) add a tenant-specific circuit-breaker in routing to automatically steer to fallback model when queue_wait > 3s; 3) add alerts for cbatcher_pending_batches > 200 for 5m.
ben_oncall: I'll file postmortem and link to runbook. Repro notes included in ticket: use stress script `clients/stress_gen.sh --concurrency 16 --input longseq` (added to ticket).
maria_support: Sharing a short customer-facing note: "We're aware of the issue and have applied temporary mitigations (scaled pool, lowered batch size, increased temporary queue limit). Please set client concurrency to <=4 and consider using the fallback header while we investigate."
leo_infra: Adding follow-up: we found a slow path in attention kernel under long sequence lengths causing per-token runtime spikes; infra will test patch to kernel quant paths. ETA 48h for potential rollout.
ops_bot: Runbook link: https://go/runbooks/queue-saturation-guide. Postmortem created: PM-2026-0042.
ben_oncall: Closing channel for active mitigation; will update when the kernel patch is ready and after postmortem. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
kevin_support: Customer notified and satisfied for now; keep me in loop for SLA credits.
maria_support: Closing thread when PM posted.
